value.title: I`m Not Your God.
value.synopsis: As Zack is looking around in Rachel's room, a TV suddenly turns on and starts playing a news story about a bizarre murder case.

value.title: Swear You Will Be Killed by Me.
value.synopsis: Zach confronts Rachel after learning the secrets of her past.

value.title: A Vow Cannot Be Stolen.
value.synopsis: Zack and Rachel have found the stairway leading to the building's exit. At last, the end of their ordeal is in sight... but as they're climbing the stairs, suddenly an alarm sounds.

value.title: Stop Crying and Smile.
value.synopsis: Zack struggles to get Rachel outside the building. But what kind of future awaits her on the outside?
